name: elm-lang-tunguski
description: Editor support for the from-scratch tunguski/elm-lang toolchain: diagnostics, hover types, go-to-definition, completion, references, rename, outline, inlay hints, signature help and semantic highlighting — all served by `elm lsp`.

elmLang.serverJar.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the built `elm.jar` (the shaded CLI, produced by `mvn package`). If empty, the extension looks for `target/elm.jar` under the workspace root.

elmLang.javaPath.description: Path to the `java` executable used to launch the language server.

elmLang.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and the Elm language server.
